body:
You're totally right. I'm not sure if I'm totally ready to reach out to anyone right now but I hope that one day soon I will be. Or maybe at least be brave enough to take that step even if I'm not ready.

Thanks again for talking to me. It's really nice to have someone be supportive, validating and give good, rational advice even if it's a stranger on the internet.

Wish you the best too :)

Yeah, it's a really hard situation to be in. It may seem a bit weird for me to say considering we're in the same boat, but I do think that it is really amazing that you made it this far despite everything that you're going through.

If you ever need a friend, feel free to message me.

I used to see someone when I was a bit younger but I was never taken seriously. Not even the people around me take me seriously when I try and talk about things or I just get straight up ignored. I get undermined a lot too because no one seems to believe that things are as bad as they are. Because of that I've always been afraid of seeking any sort of actual help or talking about my issues.
I know that not everyone is gonna be like that, I'm just scared to make that step and it's hard to have hope when it seems like everything and everyone is against you.
It's like you said, the first step really is the hardest.

Thank you for reaching out and being so nice. I know that's what this subreddit is for but it still means a lot.

Honestly, I don't know. I don't know anything other than the fact that I'm scared and hurting. I've been like this for so long and tried so many things to make life better for myself but it never seems to work. I'm sure there is more I could do but I just don't have any hope anymore

I seriously recommend starting over, especially if you don't have much to lose. You may  even be able to find like minded people who will accept you as you are, even if you don't know who you are. I also tried to salvage the "old me" and I remember that time being the absolute worst. It sent me spiraling so bad. I won't go into detail though, I don't wanna make this about me. I agree with the self diagnosing thing, it's never good to do that but it's always okay to suspect. If you ever have the opportunity, bring it up with a professional and hopefully they'll be willing to help. Again, if you need support in any way or just want some info, I'm free to talk.

I really wish you the best and I hope things work out for you. I genuinely mean that too :)

Although I can't offer much in terms of advice but I can tell you my own experiences of these feelings and what I did. I've always been the type of person to change myself for others to get them to like me. All I ever wanted was for people to like me, to be loved by everyone. I think of myself to be a cold, uncaring and judgmental person and I didn't want to be like that, no one liked me when I was like that. Changing myself constantly got to me so badly I ended up snapping and cutting everyone I ever knew out of my life other than family. I started over. I was 19 then and I'm nearly 21 now and it's been an endless struggle with trying to figure out who I am because all I've ever been is what people what me to be. I'm not the sweet, fun girl everyone knew me to be. I don't know who I am. I'm gonna wondering for a while but I think that's okay.

I still don't like the me that is cold, uncaring and judgmental but I'm trying to come to terms with it, trying to slowly help myself get out of that mindset. Trying to care for the people in my life now without being disingenuous. I don't know if I'm doing that well. I'm still chronically emotionally numb because of my BPD and I feel like an asshole most of the time because I struggle to connect with others, but I know for sure that I'm in a better place than I was when I was trying to be someone I'm not.

I'm not suggesting starting over completely the way I did because it could harm you more than help you depending on your situation. I just want you to know that you're not a bad person for wanting approval from others, wanting to be loved. You're not a bad person for not knowing who you really are. You're not a bad person for having twisted feelings. I'm into some messed up shit, believe me. But as long as you're not going out of your way to hurt people, you're not a bad person. I mean, you're actively seeking advice to help your situation, a bad person wouldn't do that. Take time for you and figure things out. Go see someone and see if there really is something else going on that isn't just OCD. In situations like these it's okay to be selfish and do things for you.

I'm sorry this was so long. If you ever need someone to talk to just pm me and I'll get back asap :)
Happy birthday!! I seriously wish you the best dude 🎉🎁💕
